page.overview:
Who is Che-Che?

Che-Che is one of Marc-Ange Draco's thugs in the 1969 film On Her Majesty's Secret Service. He was portrayed by Irvin Allen.

He was first seen when he attacked James Bond in Tracy Draco's hotel room in Monte Carlo. He was beat by Bond. Later, he listened the conversation of Bond and Tracy. He was also a member of the team that took Bond to Marc-Ange Draco the next day. He was there when Bond joined Draco and his Union Corse henchmen in a mercenary helicopter assault on Piz Gloria, in hopes of destroying the facility and rescuing Tracy. Also, Che-Che is seen using a Backpack Flamethrower during the raid. He was last seen as a guest in Bond and Tracy's wedding.
